admission.base_signal: Exact frozen ASHARE-QUIET-INVENTORY-INFORMATION-GAP-BREAKOUT-V1 candidate identity; no chart-selected rows

regime_lanes.BROAD_AND_SECTOR_BULL: frozen PIT broad-market regime is BULL and industry-local-bull conditions pass
regime_lanes.SECTOR_BULL_ONLY: frozen PIT broad-market regime is not BULL, market-crash veto passes, and industry-local-bull conditions pass

economic_hypothesis: A low-volatility, low-turnover forty-session inventory platform that gaps upward on expanded turnover is a repricing candidate. A broad bull market is not required when capital is causally concentrated in a healthy and improving PIT industry, provided the whole market is not in a crash state.
entry: First legal next daily open within three market sessions after the completed signal close

evidence_governance.post_2023_data: Only rows needed to resolve positions signaled no later than 2023-12-31
evidence_governance.prior_outcome_exposure: Related predecessor outcomes have been observed; this is iterative research, not pristine external validation

independence: No collapse-gap, true-gap repair, V6/V7/V26 event identity, or downward-gap feature is used

portfolio.capital: 50% Main Board sleeve and 50% ChiNext sleeve; no cross-sleeve transfer
portfolio.collision_rank: higher PIT industry positive-return_20d share, then higher stock-minus-industry return_20d, then higher frozen turnover expansion, then event_id

signal_clock: Completed daily close; every required feature latest_source_timestamp <= decision_at
target: +15% in QD-010 coordinate, standing from the first T+1-sellable session
time_stop: H15 completed-session state, exit at the next legal daily open
